tickets.title: [A1] ingest_timetable_snapshot (DONE - reference implementation)
tickets.body:
Reference implementation already in the repo: `mcp_servers/schedule_mcp/tools/ingest.py`.

Read it before starting A3-A5: it defines the house style for every other tool - envelope, warnings, error codes, and the empty-result rule.

**DoD**: closed on repo creation.

tickets.title: [A2] detect_timetable_changes (DONE - reference implementation)
tickets.body:
Reference implementation in `mcp_servers/schedule_mcp/tools/changes.py`.

This is the tool that makes the project robust to the university editing the timetable mid-term, and it is the tool whose result decides whether the agent re-plans.

**DoD**: closed on repo creation.

tickets.title: [A3] Implement detect_schedule_conflicts
tickets.body:
Implement `mcp_servers/schedule_mcp/tools/conflicts.py`. The full specification is in that file's docstring; the contract is fixed in `schemas.CONFLICTS_INPUT/OUTPUT`.

**Do not change the schema** without also updating `docs/03-tool-contracts.md` in the same PR.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] hard / soft / travel-gap / session-overlap conflicts all produced
- [ ] zero conflicts returns `ok=true` with `conflict_count: 0` (never an error)
- [ ] unknown `session_id` -> `INVALID_INPUT` listing the offending ids
- [ ] missing calendar file -> `DATA_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE`
- [ ] `tests/test_conflicts.py` covers all five cases
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `pytest` green

tickets.title: [A4] Implement optimize_attendance_plan
tickets.body:
The core of the project. Full specification in the docstring of `mcp_servers/schedule_mcp/tools/optimize.py`.

Reuse `detect_schedule_conflicts` for the overlap maths - do not re-implement it.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] `balanced` objective beats the home-group baseline on the demo dataset (fewer campus days at >= 0.75 coverage)
- [ ] every skipped required session carries a machine-readable reason
- [ ] `max_campus_days: 1` reaches `INFEASIBLE` with the binding constraint in `details`
- [ ] deterministic: same input -> same `plan_id`
- [ ] `tests/test_optimizer.py` green

tickets.title: [A5] Implement compare_attendance_plans
tickets.body:
Specification in the docstring of `mcp_servers/schedule_mcp/tools/compare.py`.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] verdict supported / contradicted / inconclusive derived from numbers only, no LLM inside the tool
- [ ] plans from different snapshots produce a warning, never a silent comparison
- [ ] `recommended_plan_id` rule implemented and documented
- [ ] tests cover all three verdicts

tickets.title: [A6] Domain unit tests + deterministic fixtures
tickets.body:
Round out `tests/` so the whole server is covered without a network or a browser.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] parser: malformed time, duplicate row, empty table, changed layout
- [ ] store: snapshot round-trip, `SNAPSHOT_NOT_FOUND`
- [ ] one test asserts every tool returns the envelope shape
- [ ] `pytest` runs offline in under 10 seconds

tickets.title: [A7] Error-taxonomy review across all five tools
tickets.body:
Rubric section 6 scores whether failure is distinguishable from a successful empty result.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] a table in `docs/03-tool-contracts.md` mapping every tool to the error codes it can emit
- [ ] no tool signals emptiness with an error, and no tool signals failure with an empty payload
- [ ] `retryable` is set truthfully everywhere
- [ ] one scripted command per error code that reproduces it

tickets.title: [B1] Verify Playwright MCP connection and record its real contract
tickets.body:
Start `npx -y @playwright/mcp@latest --headless --isolated` and run `python -m agent.run --discover-only`.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] both connections listed in the output, pasted into the PR description
- [ ] the exact tool names + JSON schemas of the navigate and snapshot tools saved to `docs/playwright-tools.json` (dumped from the live server, not written from memory)
- [ ] the pinned version recorded in the README

tickets.title: [B2] Implement PlaywrightTools.capture_timetable
tickets.body:
Implement in `agent/tools_facade.py` using the tool names recorded in B1.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] navigates to `SCHEDULE_URL`, waits for `SCHEDULE_TABLE_SELECTOR`, returns the timetable markup
- [ ] respects `SCRAPE_MIN_INTERVAL_SEC`
- [ ] raises a typed error on: unreachable page, selector never appearing, browser failing to start
- [ ] no credentials, no form submission, read-only navigation only

tickets.title: [B3] Implement the graph nodes conflicts / optimize / compare / report
tickets.body:
Fill the `NotImplementedError` nodes in `agent/graph.py`.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] `optimize` builds BOTH a home-group baseline plan and an optimised plan, so `compare` has something to compare
- [ ] on `INFEASIBLE`, relax `max_campus_days` by one and retry at most twice, then report the binding constraint
- [ ] `report` only phrases numbers that exist in the state; no arithmetic in the prompt
- [ ] every MCP call is logged with its arguments

tickets.title: [B4] Assemble and verify the LangGraph routing
tickets.body:
Rubric section 4 requires that tool results influence subsequent behaviour.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] `replan_required=false` demonstrably short-circuits straight to `report`
- [ ] `replan_required=true` runs the full optimisation branch
- [ ] a rendered graph diagram committed to `docs/img/graph.png` (or a mermaid block in `docs/06-architecture.md`)
- [ ] `python -m agent.run --offline` completes end to end

tickets.title: [B5] Failure handling and offline replay mode
tickets.body:
Rubric section 5 requires a realistic, clearly surfaced failure of the existing MCP server.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] three reproducible failure modes: server not started, unreachable URL, selector that never matches
- [ ] each one is reported to the user with the cause, and the run continues in degraded mode from the fixture
- [ ] `degraded_reason` is visible in the final output - the user is never silently given fixture data as if it were live
- [ ] `OFFLINE_MODE=true` never opens a socket
- [ ] the fixture path goes through the same parser as the live path (documented in the PR)

tickets.title: [B6] Final report rendering via OpenRouter
tickets.body:
**Definition of done**
- [ ] model id read from `OPENROUTER_MODEL`, key from env, never committed
- [ ] the report states: which days to come to campus, which group's session per course, what is skipped and why, and whether the stated preference was met
- [ ] a `--json` flag prints the raw state instead, for tracing values at the defence
- [ ] the run works with the LLM disabled (`--no-llm` prints a deterministic template)

tickets.title: [B7] CLI ergonomics for the defence
tickets.body:
**Definition of done**
- [ ] `--discover-only`, `--offline`, `--json`, `--previous-plan-id` all work
- [ ] one flag switches the fixture between v1 and v2 so the change-detection loop can be shown live
- [ ] output readable on a shared screen (no wall of JSON by default)

tickets.title: [C1] README: prerequisites, install, config, independent start commands
tickets.body:
Submission requirement 3.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] separate, copy-pasteable start commands for the custom server and for the agent
- [ ] pinned Playwright MCP version
- [ ] `.env.example` walkthrough, explicit statement that no secret is committed
- [ ] a from-scratch clone reproduces the offline demo (verified by a teammate, not the author)

tickets.title: [C2] Part C contracts for all five custom tools
tickets.body:
Fill `docs/03-tool-contracts.md` using the exact eight-row table the assignment prescribes: Name, Purpose, Model-facing description, Input schema, Output schema, Error conditions, Side effects, Example.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] the model-facing description is copied verbatim from `server.py`, not paraphrased
- [ ] every example input/output pair is a real captured call, not invented
- [ ] side effects stated explicitly, including 'none'

tickets.title: [C3] Document the Playwright MCP tool contract in project context
tickets.body:
Part A requires an explanation of one existing tool's name, description, arguments and constraints, returned content, error conditions and side effects - written in the context of THIS project.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] one navigate/snapshot tool documented from the dumped schema in `docs/playwright-tools.json`
- [ ] a paragraph justifying why a browser-driving server is the right choice here (no public timetable API)
- [ ] the safety boundary stated: public page only, read-only, no credentials

tickets.title: [C4] Design rationale
tickets.body:
Submission requirement 6.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] why the existing server is relevant
- [ ] why each custom tool belongs at the MCP boundary rather than inside the agent
- [ ] how the tool set supports the workflow (the replan loop specifically)
- [ ] trade-offs and known limitations, stated honestly

tickets.title: [C5] Defence script and demo checklist
tickets.body:
Submission requirement 7, and it maps 1:1 to the nine numbered demo steps in the assignment.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] a timed script matching the 2 / 2-3 / 3-4 / 2 / 3-4 minute segments
- [ ] the exact commands to type, in order
- [ ] one changed valid input and one invalid input identified in advance
- [ ] one value chosen to trace from source page to final output

tickets.title: [C6] Fixtures and replay instructions
tickets.body:
**Definition of done**
- [ ] `fixtures/README.md` explains how each fixture was recorded and how to re-record it
- [ ] explicit statement (and proof) that replay uses the same parsing path, not a canned answer
- [ ] the demo dataset documented as the deterministic input

tickets.title: [C7] Operational and security review
tickets.body:
Part D.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] `git log -p | grep -Ei 'sk-|api[_-]?key|token'` clean across the whole history
- [ ] `.env` ignored and never committed; `.env.example` complete
- [ ] rate limiting present and documented
- [ ] side effects of the custom server limited to `.state/`, which is git-ignored

tickets.title: [C8] Rubric self-check
tickets.body:
Go through `docs/07-rubric-selfcheck.md` and mark every row with evidence (file path, command, or timestamp in the demo script). Anything unproven becomes a new ticket.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] all four minimum-condition rules verifiably satisfied
- [ ] every rubric row has a concrete piece of evidence

tickets.title: [D1] End-to-end rehearsal, offline
tickets.body:
Fresh clone, fresh venv, `OFFLINE_MODE=true`, full run, on a machine that is not the author's.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] server started independently in one terminal, agent in another
- [ ] the whole nine-step demo sequence performed once without edits
- [ ] every deviation from the script filed as a ticket

tickets.title: [D2] End-to-end rehearsal, live page
tickets.body:
Same as D1 but against the real timetable URL through Playwright MCP.

**Definition of done**
- [ ] a live snapshot ingested and used in the plan
- [ ] a value traced from a cell on the page to a line of the final report
- [ ] the run repeated twice to confirm identical snapshot_id when the page is unchanged

tickets.title: [D3] Failure-scenario rehearsal
tickets.body:
**Definition of done**
- [ ] Playwright MCP not started -> agent reports it and degrades, on camera
- [ ] invalid tool input rejected at the MCP schema layer -> message shown
- [ ] `INFEASIBLE` from the optimiser -> agent relaxes a constraint and retries
- [ ] each one reproducible with a single documented command

tickets.title: [D4] Final repository review before submission
tickets.body:
**Definition of done**
- [ ] every submission item (1-7) present and linked from the README
- [ ] no open ticket labelled `rubric`
- [ ] repository readable by someone who has never seen it: a teammate follows the README cold and succeeds
